newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Cerebos says expects tough second half.
newsitem.headline: Cerebos says expects tough second half.

text.p: Food based Cerebos Pacific Ltd said on Tuesday it expected a tougher second half due to slower growth in Asian economies and difficult trading conditions in Australia and New Zealand.
The group reported flat profit of Singapore $47.01 million for the six months ended March 31 1997.
For the first half period under review, group sales slipped three percent to S$338.10 million.
Cerebos said the lower turnover was due to the declining economies in Asia, tight credit conditions in China and also the termination of a distribution agreement for a product line in Australia.
Cerebos results are below market expectations.
Analysts had expected the group, which sells Brand's Essence of Chicken, to report single digit growth of just under 10 percent.
The Edinburgh Financial Publishing's Estimate Directory has a full year concensus forecast for the group of S$113.5 million for 1997, up 11 percent over 1996.
